name: Cheesy Ham-Bell Pepper Alfredo Flatbread with Hot Honey & Lemony Arugula (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use these recipes as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 red bell pepper
½ lemon
½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim and seed bell pepper. Slice half into thin strips; medium dice remaining bell pepper. Place both on a plate, keeping them separate.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the bell pepper.
Medium dice ham. Add to the plate.

Divide flatbreads between two baking sheet pans. Spread each with Alfredo sauce, then top with diced ham and cheese. Top 2 of the flatbreads with diced bell pepper and sliced onion. (Reserve bell pepper strips for the kid plates.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Alfredo sauce
1 ½ cups mozzarella cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until flatbreads are lightly crispy and cheese is melted, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place honey and crushed red pepper in a small bowl, then stir to combine the hot honey. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
honey
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, additional honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add arugula, toss to coat, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the flatbreads are done, cut into wedges.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide the ham and cheese flatbread between plates along with bell pepper strips and pineapple. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining flatbreads between plates. Drizzle with hot honey, top with dressed arugula (or eat as a side salad), and enjoy!
